verdict.tagline: Chaotic co-op scavenging where survival demands a crew.
for_you_if: you play with a regular group of friends
you enjoy chaotic cooperative multiplayer moments
you want games that run well on modest hardware
not_for_you_if: you plan to play entirely solo
you run into public lobby matchmaking issues
you need active developer content updates

cohorts.label: 20-100h
cohorts.summary: Procedural generation creates varied runs, though playing alone proves difficult and public lobbies suffer from cheaters.

claims.claim: The game features procedural generation for its complex maps using a different seed for each chosen planet.

citations.review_text:
Oh this indie extraction looter game is just ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ funnnnnn dude.

Like genuinely geta few buddies along or play with randos and you'll be clip farming like crazy with how many insanely funny moments and cool people you'll meet because of this game.

Its premise is simple, choose a planet to land on, go to the complex which is proceduraly generated according to a different seed each time. And get as much loot as possible before it gets dark whilst trying not to die by the various traps and spooks in the complex.

I really have alot of fun with this game, its genuinely a blast in multiplayer and it gets really cheap on a steam sale.

Really worth your money.

Amazing game to play with friends, We just mess around basically the whole time and its extremely fun. Monsters make it difficult so its not always easy. Many mods too from thunderstore that are amazing

claims.claim: The game can be played as a single-player experience offline, though reviewers note that playing alone is much less enjoyable or virtually impossible compared to playing with others.

cohorts.label: 100h+
cohorts.summary: Long-term players note matchmaking frustrations and hardware friendliness, emphasizing that the experience requires a group.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the online matchmaking system as problematic, noting that it takes a long time to fill a lobby as host and that using quality-of-life or accessibility mods causes hosts to be automatically filtered out.

citations.review_text: The matchmaking used to be great, the last update made it awful. It takes forever to fill a lobby as host and it's still a mess trying to join randoms. Please just revert it back to what it used to be like so people can ACTUALLY run lobbies or play with other adults. This game hinges on community engagment and the last update destroyed the ability for people to connect with eachother. Playing with QOL mods means you practically cannot host a lobby because it automatically filters you out, including things like mods that allow late joins in case of a disconnect from a random or even accesibility features such as removing the character limit in the chat function.

This game needs some QoL for online lobby updates.
You often end up wasting your time trying to connect to invalid games or reconnecting to games where you've been kicked from.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game is designed to be played with friends, noting that it is not balanced for solo play and that solo runs are much harder.

citations.review_text:
[h1] Attempt at a spoiler-free review [/h1]

I am an avid lethal company player, I try to play as efficiently as possible and minmax wherever possible. The game is clearly not designed with that in mind, and yet it's still fun! The person behind it, Zeekerss, isn't new to game development but this is one of their more 'grounded' titles that they've released. It still retains a silly side.

This game is meant to be played with friends. Yes, there are some very [i] minor [/i] difficulty adjustments for solo play (Mostly surrounding entities that revolve around teamwork and staying close to others), they are insubstantial. If you're more casual it's better off playing with friends. The price tag is misleading because it's not uncommon to hear people buy this game along with a few extra copies for friends.
It's probably impossible to not have been spoiled of the contents of this game if you've been on the internet for the last couple years but if you've somehow not played it yet, find a time and a group of friends for it! I'm sure you'll have a blast, and also a crap in your pants. A little pee too! This game is scary!!!!

This is one of my favourite videogames ever and if you're anything like me, it'll be one of yours too.

It's the most fun a game can be that has no more than a 10-15 minute gameplay loop, but of course is held back for this same reason. Not at all balanced for solo and is completely unfair sometimes, but I would recommend for casual

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game is not demanding on PC hardware and can run well even on older or less expensive computers.

citations.review_text: Good game, it's super fun even with just two people playing, I would recommend mods though as it adds more to the experience. Monsters are scary, atmosphere is on point. It is a bit weirdly optimised so at times on my old computer it ran super slow even though it's not a big game or anything.
Great game, amazing to play with friends, not very demanding for your pc to run so you dont need something super expensif. Definitly worth the price.
